Why should we care about creating an Agentic OS if we are already happy with Claude Code?

Well, its because Agentic OS fundamentals are tightly tied to Claude Code fundamentals, and mastering the former improves your outputs with the latter. 

From skills, to loop engineering, to memory management, a strong Claude OS foundation lends itself to virtually any project you tackle with Claude Code natively while giving you the benefits of extreme customization, a visual interface, and a package that can be shared with nontechnical teams.
